features.customization: Named leaderboard column views saved per device; batting/pitching/fielding in Leaderboards; 44 metrics per opponent hand selectable in tables, player/team headers, live matchups, and app percentiles.
features.percentiles: Selectable metrics, peer group, sample qualifier including L/R PA or BBE, minimum sample and ranking direction; midpoint ties; minimum five valid peers. Official Savant percentiles remain separate.
features.games: Fixed box-score order; regular-season and postseason append scopes; English inning scorecard; color-coded PBP and live center; filterable pitch log.
features.intensity: Version 6 editorial scale spans 1–100, official WPA rating with clearly labeled score-only fallback; unavailable for unplayed games; game/series filters and sorting.
features.postseason: Bracket and series list, league/round/minimum-intensity filters, champion banner, game detail and best-of series summaries.
features.ui: Dark Scorebook style with colored section headers, result chips, metric families, live count/base panels, retained dark color themes.
features.removed: Split lab and obsolete formula leaderboard removed from navigation; old links redirect to Leaderboards. Simulator remains removed.

sources.savantPlayer: Safely parsed public player summary, section catalog, explicitly year-scoped published tables and datasets. Live fetch plus verified fallback for Judge, Cole and Realmuto; service failures stay explicit.

limits: Interactive browser QA unavailable: no control-browser skill in this environment.
Some official interactive Savant visuals lack accessible season-scoped records; app states unavailable and links the official section. No other season is substituted.
Live data and private deployed endpoints are checked after publication; snapshot coverage is shown in the app.
Saved layouts are local to the browser/device.
